ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Federal Bank has allotted a total of 78,525 new equity shares on September 27, 2026, following the exercise of employee stock options under various ESOS and ESIS schemes. This is a standard operational announcement, duly approved by the Nomination, Remuneration, Ethics and Compensation Committee. The resulting minor share dilution and capital inflow are unlikely to have a material financial impact on the bank, and no red flags are identified.
